LanguageData.CC_Welcome_Text:
Your colonists are more than workers now. They ask for things and remember how you answered, make friends and rivals, keep journals and dream, and meet in council to choose what the colony works toward.

All of it is in the council window: open it with the council button {0}. Its first page shows the colony at a glance, and Priorities lists what the colony needs most.

New to it? The Almanac, the last part of the council window, has a "Start here" page with the main parts in a few lines and links to the rest. Every part can be turned down or off in the mod settings.

This letter comes only once.
